prompt:
Use case: compositing / identity-preserving family portrait.
Create ONE family portrait of these THREE approved Goho characters together, preserving their individual designs closely.
Image1: BRAM, original broad squat periwinkle-lilac father, exactly two small ivory horns, long heavy plump rounded hanging arms, tiny feet, glossy dark oval eyes and simple closed curved smile, NO curl or eyebrows.
Image2: MIRA, warm rosy-coral mother with broad rounded pear body, one integrated curled crown tuft, expressive subtle asymmetric brows, glossy dark oval eyes, curved smile, tiny feet and her friendly rounded arms. NO horns.
Image3: THEIR LITTLE ONE, buttery-yellow child with Mira's curl and eyebrows, Bram's two ivory horn buds and plump rounded arms, dark oval eyes, joyful closed smile and tiny yellow feet.

COMPOSITION:
Warm, affectionate full-body family portrait, landscape 3:2. Bram on viewer LEFT, Mira on viewer RIGHT, their smaller child in the CENTER slightly in front. Child's full height around 58% of Mira's and 68% of Bram's. All three stand on the same believable ground plane, feet clearly visible; child slightly forward so faces remain unobscured. Adults naturally lean inward very subtly toward the child. Bram's near arm rests gently beside the child and Mira's near arm lightly embraces the child's side, soft rounded tips with no fingers. Keep the child clearly visible as a complete yellow silhouette, not squeezed or hidden. The family feels close and affectionate, not three disconnected cutouts; relaxed smiles, looking at the viewer. The parent heights and body silhouettes stay distinctive: Bram noticeably wider and lower, Mira taller with her curl; child truly small and round. All curls, horns, arms and feet inside image with generous margins.

PRESERVE:
Keep each character's EXACT approved face, features, color and recognizable silhouette from the references. Bram stays lilac, Mira stays coral, child stays buttery yellow. Do not transfer Mira's eyebrows or curl to Bram; do not give Mira horns. Do not recolor, redesign, humanize or add anatomy. Maintain the reference matte velvety clay finish, subtle fine texture, soft diffuse studio lighting, glossy dark eyes with white highlights and understated smiles. No shiny toy plastic, fur or fabric.

BACKGROUND:
Simple seamless warm ivory studio background like the original family reference, small soft contact shadows, calm generous negative space. No text, names, frame, border, logo, props, hearts, confetti, accessories, clothing or extra characters. One polished family portrait, not a collage with panels.
